meta.name: trojan_horse_troy
meta.prompt: The Trojan horse in Troy, right before the soldiers emerge.

programs.brief: The colossal hollow wooden horse carpentered from pine and ship timber, set on a heavy wheeled timber base. Features discreet belly trapdoor seams, subtle access ladder rungs along the flank, and horse-head prow styling.
An abandoned Greek siege machine: a timber trestle battering ram or mantlet screen draped in dried ox-hides, left discarded outside the city walls.

tokens.terrain: a walled city on a rise above a sandy plain; the Aegean shore in view
tokens.icons: the colossal wooden horse inside the city walls near the Scaean gate; high stone ramparts and watchtowers; royal megaron palace at the acropolis crest; abandoned Greek siege camp and distant beached galleys
tokens.event_context: deep night after drunken victory celebrations; armed Mycenaean soldiers quietly waiting to unbolt the wooden horse's trapdoor inside the quiet courtyard
